name: Ekko Studio ESP32-C3 Wi-Fi Setup Firmware v1
features: Wi-Fi setup portal
Open Ekko Studio-WIFI setup access point
Pre-AP Wi-Fi network scan dropdown
Manual Wi-Fi SSID fallback
Provisioning success page with LAN IP redirect
Saved Wi-Fi reconnect
LAN device tab
Fixed-port UDP Hermes endpoint discovery
Separate Web UI and desktop endpoint listing
MCU login form for discovered endpoints
Profile selection after MCU login
Socket.IO client connection to selected Hermes Web UI
Wi-Fi history scan before startup reconnect
Wi-Fi reprovisioning without clearing history
Remote active machine reauthentication
OLED status UI and idle animation
Selectable push-to-talk and local-VAD listening modes
Selectable Ekko and Hermes agent runtimes with isolated sessions
Sample-synchronized GB2312 subtitles during speech playback
Configurable connected standby with a three-minute default
